title: Add Country
vanillaNamePlaceholder: Default uses the vanilla country name
vanillaNameHint: Leave blank to use the vanilla HOI4 name. You can edit this later.
customHint: Use this for alt-history nations vanilla doesn't ship (Bavaria, Wales, Texas, ...). Type a 2-5 letter uppercase code; if it collides with a vanilla TAG you'll get a soft warning before override.
